messages:
mira: FYI ap-southeast1 cohort `nvme-refresh-03` is stalling GPU attaches, ~30 pending.
dan: seeing nvme admin timeouts on 4 hosts. small dmesg snippet:
```
[ 5432.123456] nvme nvme0: Admin timeout
[ 5432.123500] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1
```
joel: these are the nodes we updated firmware on last week. scrub windows overlapped with a large autoscaler spike.
mira: quick mitigation: taint the 4 nodes `nvme-degraded:NoSchedule` and exclude pool from autoscaler; can we throttle scrub?
dan: pushed maintenance toggle to set `scrub.parallelism=1` for that cohort and cordoned nodes.
ops-bot: ALERT GPU_PROVISIONING_HOLD ap-southeast1: 29 pending at 1749991100
joel: attach success back up after cordon+throttle. mark 2 drives for replacement and schedule follow-up: stagger firmware + scrub next rollout.
mira: agreed. please add an alert for nvme admin timeout >3 in 5m. closing for now.
